# NoxTLS STM32WB5x hardware backend: host unit tests (UTNox) against a functional
# AES1 / PKA / RNG / HSEM register model (ut_wb_mock.c). The model replaces
# noxtls_stm32wb_bus.c, computes AES / GCM / CCM with an independent reference
# (ut_wb_ref.c) and checks the PKA RAM layout operand by operand. Known answers
# are generated by gen_vectors.py (OpenSSL via python-cryptography, textbook P-256).
# The NoxTLS AES modes and the DRBG entropy hook are linked unmodified, so the same
# vectors are run through the real library on hardware and on the software path.
#
# Standalone build and coverage (see ut/nrf54/CMakeLists.txt for the toolchain notes):
#   export PATH=/c/msys64/mingw64/bin:$PATH
#   cmake -S components/noxtls/ut/stm32wb -B build/noxtls_stm32wb_ut -G Ninja -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=gcc -DENABLE_COVERAGE=ON
#   cmake --build build/noxtls_stm32wb_ut && ctest --test-dir build/noxtls_stm32wb_ut --output-on-failure
#   gcovr -r components/noxtls --filter '.*vendor/st/stm32wb/.*' --exclude-unreachable-branches \
#         --txt-metric branch build/noxtls_stm32wb_ut
# UTNOX_DIR selects the UTNox checkout (default: ../../../utnox/utnox, then the BlueNox copy in
# a shared component workspace).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(NoxtlsStm32wbUt LANGUAGES C)
enable_testing()

option(ENABLE_COVERAGE "Enable gcov code coverage instrumentation" OFF)

get_filename_component(_wb_ut_root "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../.." ABSOLUTE)
if(NOT UTNOX_DIR)
  set(UTNOX_DIR "${_wb_ut_root}/../utnox/utnox")
  if(NOT EXISTS "${UTNOX_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt")
    set(UTNOX_DIR "${_wb_ut_root}/../bluenox-stack/utnox/utnox")
  endif()
endif()
if(NOT EXISTS "${UTNOX_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "UTNox not found (set UTNOX_DIR): ${UTNOX_DIR}")
endif()
if(ENABLE_COVERAGE)
  set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} --coverage -O0")
  set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} --coverage")
endif()
set(UTNOX_BUILD_SUITE_RUNNER OFF CACHE BOOL "Build utnox_suite" FORCE)
if(NOT TARGET utnox)
  add_subdirectory("${UTNOX_DIR}" utnox)
endif()

set(_lib "${_wb_ut_root}/noxtls-lib")
set(_wb "${_lib}/vendor/st/stm32wb")

# Backend under test (everything except the volatile MMIO file, which the model replaces).
set(WB_BACKEND_SOURCES
  ${_wb}/noxtls_stm32wb_hsem.c
  ${_wb}/noxtls_stm32wb_aes.c
  ${_wb}/noxtls_stm32wb_aead.c
  ${_wb}/noxtls_stm32wb_pka.c
  ${_wb}/noxtls_stm32wb_rng.c
  ${_wb}/noxtls_stm32wb_port_aes.c
  ${_wb}/noxtls_stm32wb_port_ecc.c
  ${_wb}/noxtls_stm32wb_port_drbg.c
  ${_wb}/noxtls_stm32wb_port_bn.c
  ${_wb}/noxtls_stm32wb_accel.c)

# NoxTLS pieces linked unmodified: AES modes, DRBG, helpers, big-number platform hook table.
set(WB_LIB_SOURCES
  ${_lib}/encryption/aes/noxtls_aes.c
  ${_lib}/encryption/aes/noxtls_aes_ecb.c
  ${_lib}/encryption/aes/noxtls_aes_cbc.c
  ${_lib}/encryption/aes/noxtls_aes_ctr.c
  ${_lib}/encryption/aes/noxtls_aes_cfb.c
  ${_lib}/encryption/aes/noxtls_aes_ofb.c
  ${_lib}/encryption/aes/noxtls_aes_xts.c
  ${_lib}/encryption/aes/noxtls_aes_ccm.c
  ${_lib}/encryption/aes/noxtls_aes_gcm.c
  ${_lib}/encryption/aes/noxtls_aes_cmac.c
  ${_lib}/drbg/noxtls_drbg.c
  ${_lib}/common/noxtls_ct.c
  ${_lib}/common/noxtls_memory.c
  ${_lib}/pkc/rsa/noxtls_bn_platform.c)

add_executable(noxtls_stm32wb_ut
  ut_wb_mock.c
  ut_wb_ref.c
  ut_wb_stubs.c
  ut_wb_vectors.c
  test_wb_hsem.c
  test_wb_aes.c
  test_wb_aead.c
  test_wb_rng.c
  test_wb_pka.c
  test_wb_ports.c
  test_wb_lib.c
  ${WB_BACKEND_SOURCES}
  ${WB_LIB_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(noxtls_stm32wb_ut PRIVATE
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
  ${_wb_ut_root}
  ${_lib}
  ${_lib}/common
  ${_lib}/encryption/aes
  ${_lib}/drbg
  ${_lib}/mdigest
  ${_lib}/pkc
  ${_lib}/pkc/ecc
  ${_lib}/pkc/ecdsa
  ${_lib}/pkc/rsa
  ${_wb})
target_compile_definitions(noxtls_stm32wb_ut PRIVATE
  NOXTLS_EMBEDDED_NO_STDIO=1
  NOXTLS_FEATURE_AES_ACCEL_NI=0
  NOXTLS_FEATURE_AES_ACCEL_APPLE=0
  NOXTLS_PORT_AES_ACCEL=1
  NOXTLS_FEATURE_STM32WB_HW_ACCEL=1
  NOXTLS_FEATURE_BIGNUM=1)
target_link_libraries(noxtls_stm32wb_ut PRIVATE utnox)
if(WIN32)
  target_link_libraries(noxtls_stm32wb_ut PRIVATE advapi32)
endif()
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
  target_compile_options(noxtls_stm32wb_ut PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)
endif()
add_test(NAME noxtls_stm32wb_ut COMMAND noxtls_stm32wb_ut run_all)
